source: Report-only single-flow capture of the already-accepted assembled SSE leg TestCF003AssembledTransactionTransportMatrix (@ 43ed443, SSE cardinality-boundary leg @ e2d97ae, 2x race green) under FU-02 Option A; no corpusctl recorder behavior change, no v1 oracle. One subscriber only: a single SSE connection on the owned isolated transactions-cardinality-boundary fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003) reproduces the SSE leg step for step — seed, init, positive transact converging past the seed watermark, exact validation denial mutating nothing, same-batch cardinality-one batch with the final value winning exactly once. The seed admin transact runs live; every GET/POST exchange and all 5 stream data frames replay exactly under the documented masking rule.
redaction: CF-002 discipline: volatile transport headers (Date, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding) excluded; SSE heartbeat comment records (: ping keepalives, timing-dependent) excluded — only parsed data-payload objects are compared, key order insignificant. Masking rule (mechanical, enforced by the replay test): session-bearing string values are never checked in. The checked-in POST bodies and stream frames carry sentinel placeholders <card-transport-session>, <card-token>, <card-machine-id>, <card-protocol-session>, <card-attr-id-todos-id>, <card-attr-id-todos-title> in exactly the positions the live server emits random values (transport handshake session-id/sse-token/machine-id, POST session_id/sse_token, protocol-init session-id, attr id fields, transact title-attr positions). The replay test substitutes the live values into the templates (POSTs) and masks the live frames back to the sentinels (stream) before whole-result reflect.DeepEqual; any checked-in real session value (any sess- substring) or missing sentinel fails the test before any byte is replayed. The transact-ok watermarks (tx-id 2 and 3) are deterministic across fresh isolated DBs (seed tx 1, denial minting nothing, proven byte-stable on two runs) and are asserted exactly equal to the live tx-ids as float64. Application payload keys (titles, entity IDs, op names, event IDs, app-id) are retained exactly and remain comparison-significant. No timestamps, DSNs, or database URLs appear in these bytes.
excluded: Excluded with reason: (1) the seed admin transact (POST /admin/transact) — its response carries a transaction watermark (tx-id 1) tied to database state and its request carries the credential-bearing X-admin-token header, so exact byte check-in is inappropriate; it runs live with the accepted assembled-leg shape (200 with a positive tx-id asserted live). (2) Teardown-poll intermediate 200 empty envelopes — the count of 200s before the dead-reader teardown lands is timing-dependent; only the terminal 401 unknown sse session exchange is checked in and it is asserted live after a bounded poll, mirroring the accepted leg. (3) HTTP query convergence bodies — the unfiltered todos query over POST /runtime/framework/query converges byte-exactly (transport-baseline, sse-one, sse-one-after-denial byte-identical, sse-card-last) and is asserted live whole-body with whole-result DeepEqual lengths-before-elements rather than checked in, since the query path is the convergence oracle, not the stream under capture. (4) The WS legs of the transport matrix (WS positive write, WS denial, WS cardinality batch, WS watermark chain) — WS recording stays excluded by enforcement (CF-002 record --transport ws fails closed), so no WS evidence is checked in and no WS claim is made; the WS variant of this row remains excluded. (5) HTTP runtime-transact legs (dcc8373/255e28b) are supporting-only and are not reproduced here. Heartbeat comments are excluded per the redaction rule above, not a behavior exclusion.
